args.prompt:
Create ONE new KFB Slop character asset sheet,1536x1024landscape,precisely SIX UNIQUE expressive surreal-weird cartoon claymation INK BLOB MONSTERS in3columns x2rows, TRUE transparent PNG. Series "The Unexpected Residents": surprise, alarm and disorientation. SIMPLE ordinary apartment residents/passersby, light low-tier/NPC equipment, not soldiers, bosses, human-costumed heroes or conceptual contraptions. Strong emotional acting at the peak of a reaction, warm dry satire. Each stands alone.
INPUTS: image1 ORIGINAL STYLE reference for thick whole rounded body,tactile plasticine,lids and craft;image2 ORIGINAL family goo/splat morphology, NOT its repeated angry grins. These are STYLE references not edit targets; new actors not costume copies, no generated style parent.
ACCEPTED GENTLE MATERIAL LOCK: Same soft rounded rich modeled stop-motion plasticine, fine fingerprints, soft upper-left studio light and restrained satin highlights. Only slight charcoal-black ink bias versus source;subtle deep plum undertone retained. NO further aggressive blackening or flattened volume. Avoid white/lavender rim-glow, coarse gritty angular clay,fuzzy felt fibre weave on goo,glossy vinyl or polished Pixar-style human faces. Cloth/wood/brass props tactile and coherent. Lips DARK body-colored ink,not pink lipstick.
ANATOMY: EACH one complete continuous UPRIGHT FOOTLESS ink blob, asymmetrical soft rounded drooping lobes and short ink hands. Big face in body;small sparse domestic accessories,body dominant. No human torso,legs,shoes,feet,severed bust,lying,seated or puddle-only pose. All eyes have WHITE/IVORY sclera around RED iris and BLACK pupil,thick fully filled dark clay lids. No red glowing eyeballs. Any teeth descend from upper gum INSIDE mouth;closed mouths toothless, no tooth glued outside lower lip.
COMPOSITION: Landscape3x2equal cells, six equally prominent LARGE figures. Same apparent body scale in both rows;no shrinking cringing characters. Each entire silhouette includingall props/droplets comfortably occupies about84% owncell height with at least24px clear transparent safe margin on allsides. No overlaps, shared objects, cross-cell interactions,cropped edges,scenelets,floor,shadowdiscs,labels,writing,watermark or gridlines. White eye/acting readable at96px. Exactly TWO female-read designs per sheet as specified, subtly lashes/styling, no human anatomy. Distinguish silhouettes/eyes/mouth/poses BEFOREprops. No automatic grins, repeated V-brows,O-mouth slot or bottom-right tongue.
READING ORDER left-right top-bottom:
1. STARTLED: Male-read tall pear-shaped ink blob, little cream nightcap slipping sideways. Whole body recoils upright, two short ink palms held at chest, huge unequal eyes and both brows suddenly raised, tiny crooked OPEN gasp with two upper teeth. Crest lobe flung into a smooth curved hook. Startled at a sudden noise, not generic anger or screaming skull.
2. PANICKED: Female-read broad asymmetric crescent splat, subtle lashes, faded coral neck bow. Hugging one small brown paper bag in one ink hand while other palm flutters beside face. Eyes wide and looking in two nearby directions, brows slanted with acute alarm, mouth a skewed horizontal OPEN yelp with three teeth, no round O. Body twists upright without legs or running feet. Comic panic, not lying down.
3. INCREDULOUS: Male-read compact square-rounded blob with short twin uneven crests, tiny dull green collar. One hand slowly lifts a thick eyelid from BELOW the eyebrow without covering eye; other held palm-up beside body. One huge white eye and other suspicious slit, jaw pushed sideways in a CLOSED toothless incredulous grimace. Double-take frozen at its peak, not frightened.
4. FROZEN IN SHOCK: Male-read small broad bell-shaped goo body with three stumpy soft crest lobes, no costume/prop. BOTH ink hands held rigidly away from belly with tiny curled fingers. Enormous fixed forward white eyes, tiny red irises, brows nearly level, mouth tiny CLOSED flat line. Whole upright silhouette stiffened like somebody forgot the next frame. Not a humanoid statue, no grey stone material.
5. SUSPICIOUS: Male-read lean leaning comma-shaped blob, one elongated drooping crest, bare goo otherwise. One hand conceals a small blank folded cream envelope against flank, other hand curled protectively over chest. Both red irises sharply sideways within clear white sclera, one brow high other low, tight CLOSED corner mouth in watchful distrust. No spy costume, glasses or hat.
6. OVERWHELMED: Female-read wide scalloped ink blob, low curled sidequiff and modest lashes, short mustard knitted collar. Two ink hands press temples without covering eyes. One lid droops low while other eye rolls upward, brows knotted in helpless disbelief, mouth wide crooked CLOSED wavy pout. Upright body squeezed inward a little but same large cell scale. Mental overload rather than grief, no floating punctuation.
Make these ordinary residents emotionally visceral and expressive, offbeat relatable clay ink creatures. Humble props few and readable;the reaction is the identity. All image lettering absent; English names live only in metadata. Preserve rounded whole ink identity and craftsmanship.
